title: Terms & Conditions
intro: Please read these Terms & Conditions ("Terms") carefully before using the CalorieKitchen mobile application ("App"). By creating an account or continuing as a guest you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use the App.

blocks.text: CalorieKitchen is a personal nutrition and calorie-tracking tool operated by an individual developer ("we", "us", "our"). The App helps users log meals, track macros, set calorie goals, and monitor progress. It is not a medical product and is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease or health condition.

CalorieKitchen is for adults aged 18 and over. You must be at least 18 years old to use the App, including Guest Mode and AI features. We ask you to declare your age and confirm adult eligibility. Parental permission does not allow anyone under 18 to use the App. Existing users must confirm adult eligibility before continuing; saved data is retained until you request deletion or remove it. You can request account and cloud-data deletion at https://caloriekitchen-app.github.io/legal/delete-account.html even if you are no longer eligible to use the App.
You may use the App without creating an account ("Guest Mode"). When using Guest Mode:

Your guest profile, diary, weight and lists stay on your device and do not sync to a CalorieKitchen cloud account. Limited device, advertising and diagnostic information can still be transmitted as described in the Privacy Policy.
If you uninstall the App or clear its data, your guest data will be permanently lost. We cannot recover it.
You can link a Google account at any time to back up your data to the cloud.
You must sign in with Google before purchasing or restoring a subscription. Guest mode does not provide an anonymous purchase route.

CalorieKitchen is a general-purpose tracking tool and is NOT a substitute for professional medical, dietetic, or nutritional advice. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional before making significant changes to your diet or exercise routine, especially if you have a medical condition or are pregnant.

Nutritional values displayed in the App are sourced from third-party databases and user-submitted data. We do not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or suitability of any nutritional information. Use it as a guide only.
You agree to:
Provide accurate information in your profile so your calorie targets are calculated correctly.
Not use the App for any unlawful purpose or in a way that could harm others.
Keep your Google account credentials secure. You are responsible for all activity under your account.
Not reverse-engineer, decompile, or tamper with the App.

All content, design, code, and materials in the App are the property of the developer and are protected by applicable intellectual property laws. You are granted a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable licence to use the App for your personal, non-commercial use only.

The free app may display third-party ads. An active Ad-Free, Bronze, Silver or Gold subscription removes third-party ad display; additional features depend on the purchased tier. Prices, billing periods and any eligible introductory offer are shown by Google Play before purchase. Subscriptions renew unless cancelled under Google Play’s rules.

Sign in with Google in CalorieKitchen before purchasing or restoring. RevenueCat uses your Supabase account UUID to associate entitlements with the app account. The Play account that pays can differ from the Google account signed into CalorieKitchen. Use Restore purchases after signing into the intended app account; store verification is required.

Cancel renewal in Google Play’s Subscriptions settings. Signing out, uninstalling or deleting your CalorieKitchen account does not cancel a store subscription. Refund requests follow Google Play’s applicable process and your statutory rights.

Silver and Gold subscriptions include AI photo scanning (meal photos and fridge photos). Bronze and Gold subscriptions include AI data insights (recipe suggestions from your fridge, and a weekly progress observation). Using these features means:

A requested meal/fridge scan sends the resized photo through our backend to Google Gemini. Our backend does not persist the photo. Google’s API terms can permit safety/abuse-monitoring retention; provider handling is explained in the Privacy Policy.

For meal photo scanning, identified food names are also sent to the USDA FoodData Central public database (a US government nutrition database) to look up calorie and macro information. No personal data is sent to USDA — only a food name and an estimated portion size.

Recipe generation sends fridge ingredients, dietary preference, goal and recent food-name trends. Eligible progress observations can be requested automatically when you open Progress, using aggregated calorie/protein, weight and exercise/step statistics. Local diary/fridge insight cards do not call a remote AI service.
None of these features use free-form chat: you never type a prompt to the AI, and every response is a short, structured suggestion or observation, not a conversation.

AI output is a suggestion, not verified nutritional or medical advice. Check identified foods, portions and allergens before relying on a result. Usage limits apply; purchasing a subscription is not consent to every optional health-data use.

The App uses Google Sign-In, Supabase, RevenueCat, Google Play, AdMob, Sentry, Google Gemini, USDA FoodData Central, Open Food Facts and GitHub Pages as described in the Privacy Policy. These services have their own applicable terms and privacy policies. Your statutory rights are unaffected.
